native.ownership: Private fixture repositories/default suites and invisible/offscreen windows. Owned Git helper cleanup verified; no user repository writes.
native.actual_execution_note: The retained sorting wrapper also invoked the already-passed typing regression with both Git engines once. This duplicate was discovered in its log, recorded, and not repeated. Six distinct case/engine pairs pass; eight successful and four failed receivers were observed in total.

benchmark.assertions: 50k long-prefix exact paths plus NFC/NFD values/flags, decoded snapshot content, stale/consumed tickets, large+tiny warm content and unchanged/repeated retirement bytes/inode.
benchmark.limits: Single sequential samples, filesystem cache and concurrent CPU timing uncontrolled. Debug comparison is separate; later optimized run reuses recorded baseline without rerunning it. Cross-run exact bytes unclaimed because private prefixes differ. No owner archive read or modified.
benchmark.cleanup: All benchmark subprocesses reaped and private payload/HOME removed.
